name: propfuel-os
description: Connects Claude Code to the PropFuel Marketing OS (propfuel-marketing-os.vercel.app). Claude gets a briefing before PropFuel work and logs progress, initiative updates and knowledge back to the OS, credited to you. Includes 12 team marketing skills (campaigns, SEO, social, articles, brand voice, research, competitive analysis, lead lists, slides). Plus 11 LinkedIn skills (posts, comments, replies, DMs, carousels, weekly plan, profile score, audits, humanizer) that load the OS LinkedIn brain and never post for you. Plus 8 more ECC skills (email drafting, growth log, product lens, brand discovery, click-path audit, browser QA, dashboards, research ops) and 2 agents (marketing-agent, seo-specialist). Plus 13 Instagram skills (reels, captions, carousels, stories, comments, replies, DMs, weekly plan, profile score, repurposing, audits, niche research, humanizer) that load the OS Instagram brain and never post for you. Plus apple-design (Emil Kowalski, MIT): Apple's interface and fluid-motion principles for the web, for any PropFuel UI. Plus campaign-walkthrough (was winback-walkthrough, which now points to it): a prospect-branded 3-page campaign walkthrough for any use case (win-back, renewal, onboarding, acquisition, events), tailored to cold, no-show or pipeline context, their member type, AMS and email system and real Gong context, with a clickable Chili Piper CTA for the sending rep, plus cover and bump emails. Plus propfuel-interactive-demo: interactive labs prospects play with (sliders, a PropFuel switch, a plain-language side panel), math only from published proof, shipped as a noindex preview then a GitHub-built propfuel.com page. Plus propfuel-motion-ad: video ads drawn entirely in code with HyperFrames (no AI footage, people or stock): XML brief + storyboard first, a 1-second test of the hardest beat, a timestamped keyframe sheet reviewed before the render, 9:16/4:5/1:1/16:9 and a 6s bumper, safe zones, burned-in captions, H.264 export and frame-QA contact sheets; product-UI beats and an effects library (Matter.js falling word cards, Rough.js hand-drawn marks, p5.brush textured swipe, PixiJS glow/glitch, thinking-orbs AI orb, optional Anime.js), all vendored and deterministic; never uploads. Plus email-voice: learns how you write from 5-20 of your own sent emails, keeps a private voice profile (~/.claude/email-voice/<name>.md, never shared) and drafts every email in it; never sends. Plus webinar-assets: the PRE set (Zoom, email, pop-up banners), POST set (YouTube, website, platform banners) and copy (Zoom description, PropFuel email, recording page, LinkedIn, Slack) from a webinar title, date, speakers and description, with brand-rule lint and a registration-list CRM cross-check runbook; never posts or uploads. Plus webinar-deck: a webinar's slide deck and talk track from the webinar brain (21 past 2026 sessions, every slide with what was said over it); a repeat starts from its last run's deck and talk track with a change list approved first; outputs an editable PPTX with the talk track in the speaker notes plus a PDF. Plus reel-editor: installs and sets up Creator Studio (Tenfold, team-licensed) with the PropFuel house reel styles (Show and Tell, Color Block, Viral Guy) and edits raw talking-head clips into finished reels under PropFuel rules; never posts. Plus storytelling: a four-beat story loop (stakes, big question, head fake, rehook) layered on any asset's own skill; facts first, never invented. Plus 10 PYNK creative prompt skills (ugc, studio-shot, product-visuals, motion-design, ad-generator, claymation, paper-animation, talking-object, skeleton-ads, song-style-ad): they write image/video prompts you run in your own tools; never generate. Plus vertical-safe-zones: exact 9:16 safe zones for IG Reels/Stories/Feed, TikTok and Facebook Feed/Reels from the Runneth post-preview app, the combined safe box (x 100-880, y 290-1340), the make-it-as-big-as-possible rule, CSS variables, a debug overlay and frame QA. Plus the approved PropFuel logo sting (icon-only end-card animation, HyperFrames block + SFX in propfuel-motion-ad engine/assets; tagline enters separately): every asset closing screen uses it; documented in propfuel-motion-ad and reel-editor. Plus add-testimonial: "add this to the testimonial database" captures a client quote into the Notion Testimonial Library with Testifies-to tags, #testimonial-drafts and a hidden Famewall add; never publishes.
